name: Merrick Sinclair
description: JD's childhood friend and one of his first close friendships. Potsdam-area peer; cordial but more distant in recent years.
bio: Rick Sinclair's younger son. JD's childhood friend and one of his first close friendships. He dated Danielle Vetere from 2022 to 2024; they have since broken up and were never married. Cordial but more distant in recent years.
public_footprint:
Studied Speech Communication at SUNY Potsdam and appeared on the Dean's List multiple semesters (Fall 2018, Spring 2019, Fall 2020). Listed as from Canton, NY (St. Lawrence County).
